Trace, implement and test: star Sum

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Main {
    public static int starSum(int arr[],int n)
    {
        int temp[] = new int[2];
        int maximum = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            for(int j=0;j<n;j++)
            {
                boolean c1 = arr[i] + arr[j] == 18;
                boolean c2 = arr[i] > arr[j];
                boolean c3 = arr[i] * arr[j] > maximum;
                if (c1 && c2 && c3)
                {
                    maximum = arr[i] * arr[j];
                    temp[0] = arr[i];
                    temp[1] = arr[j];
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(temp[0] + " " + temp[1]);
        return 0;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = 5;
        int arr[] = {20, 16, 2, 1, 5};
        starSum(arr, n);
    }
}
